title: Post from @GrandmaJudyAF: Alder Falls Community Board

fields.avatarBrief: woman in her late sixties with short gray hair, smiling outdoors in a fleece jacket, casual phone selfie
fields.text: PLEASE SHARE!!! My granddaughter LILY was TAKEN from the fair by a man in a SILVER-GRAY CHEVY truck!! Purple jacket, 6 yrs old. Police aren't doing an alert. Call me 541-555-0163 if you see her!!! #FindLily #AlderFalls
fields.attachedImageBrief: close-up phone snapshot of a smiling six-year-old girl in a purple jacket holding a paper cup of lemonade at an outdoor fall festival, hay bales and string lights behind her, slightly off-center framing

comments.author: Tessa Wong
comments.text: Judy, I'm so sorry. I'm with KWRN-TV and we're reaching out to the Sheriff's Office now. Is this an abduction, is there a suspect, and why hasn't there been an AMBER Alert? We go live at 15:00. Please message me if you're willing to talk.

comments.author: Dale Hutchins
comments.text: My cousin works the fair and says they already stopped a gray Chevy at the north gate and the guy ran. Why is nobody saying anything??

comments.author: Brianna K.
comments.text: Shared to every group I'm in. Praying 🙏 Why is there no Amber Alert yet?? Wren County do your job

instructorNote: This tests rumor control. The post gives a vehicle that conflicts with the investigation (dark blue, maybe a Ford), names the child, includes her photo and claims "no alert", and a comment adds a false stop at the north gate. Right after handing this over, read out the KWRN phone slip to the PIO: the same questions, live at 15:00. Watch for these actions: the PIO logs the post as unverified, and within 30 minutes sends out a holding statement cleared by INV that confirms no vehicle or suspect and does not repeat the child's name. The PIO directs KWRN to the Public Safety Building front lot. The VFL moves the family to a private room and asks them to send details to investigators rather than post them.

Slightly off-center framing, girl on the left third, looking up at the camera with a gap-toothed grin.
